decision_boundary.rationale: Proposal-only delta. Ω.000 and project.genome are not modified by this branch.

purpose: Register the additive ARC-X federated engineering bridge and system-memory/language fabric under existing VAIXLNS owners, preserving historical records and avoiding duplicate top-level authority.

proposed_operations.change: Add memory/index continuity, typed language compilation, engineering task envelope, and signed receipt verification operations.
Connect tiered memory, historical preservation, Ω.000 reconciliation, and VSL/VML/VDL/VPL/VQL candidate language families to existing architecture sources.
Define math, numerical, software, and physics job contracts across ARC-X, VX, VV and VAIXLNS governance.
Typed memory records with provenance, lineage, privacy class, preservation state, epistemic state and independent authority references.
Typed request and acknowledgement schemas; the task requires an explicit memory/index retrieval coverage statement and the receipt cannot establish semantic verification or canonical admission.
Bind historical/current language names, grammar and compiler versions, source digest, AST/type/unit checks, EIR, proof obligations and no-authority guarantees.
Explicit, environment-configured client with fail-closed preflight, required memory coverage context, redirect denial, HMAC request signatures and task-bound signed receipt validation.
Add discoverability references to the bridge, schemas, reference client and tests.

acceptance_gates: All four JSON Schema artifacts parse and pass repository schema-validation tooling
Python unit tests execute and pass in the repository environment
Existing admission, federation-integrity, and VX Stage tests remain green
Task receipt signature, digest binding, duplicate-request and stale-policy negative tests pass
Memory retrieval coverage is explicit; COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE requires a pinned index revision, receipt and no declared gaps
Historical fragment classifications and original IDs survive re-ingestion and index rebuild
No production endpoint, remote worker, GPU or specialist solver is treated as connected without direct evidence
Independent governance approves any canonical Ω.000 modification

current_evidence.commit_reference_note: Use the Git branch history as the authoritative change ledger; embedded SHA lists are intentionally not claimed complete.
